value.why: tldraw sync: one server clock per room; connect {lastServerClock} gets changes since, or wipe_all when older than the tombstone history; push_result commit/discard/rebaseWithDiff; client undoes speculative edits, applies server diffs, redoes.
DDP: result and updated are separate (data visible), ready ends a subscription catch-up, version+support -> failed{version}; session resume by sentCount/receivedCount within a 15 s grace buffer.
Per-client lastMutationID bumped and checked in the same transaction as the write: id < last is alreadyProcessed, id > last is out of order; refused mutations still count as processed.
Rebase on pull: rewind to the last server state, apply the patch, replay only local mutations with id > lastMutationID; poke is a data-free hint to pull; unknown cookie gets clear + puts.
Durable Streams protocol: opaque sortable server-minted offsets, Stream-Up-To-Date vs Stream-Closed, 410 for an offset before retention, Kafka-style idempotent producers (id, epoch, seq).

y-protocols: SyncStep1/SyncStep2/Update handshake needs no seq or acks because CRDT updates are idempotent; awareness is a separate never-stored channel with per-client clocks, 15 s refresh and 30 s expiry.
Uses y-protocols framing (0 = sync, 1 = awareness); read-only can be enforced by message type prefix.

Streaming layer: nine failing-test specs (run against the real code) for client op ids, retry-once, per-op acks, reset on rewritten logs, explicit ready, gap detection, presence, version handshake and reconnect, half-open detection; plus a seven-type message vocabulary.
